items.exampleEn: She grew up in a posh part of London.
items.exampleZh: 她在倫敦的高級住宅區長大。

items.exampleEn: Many people find the color of this car unattractive.
items.exampleZh: 很多人覺得這輛車的顏色不好看。

items.exampleEn: Her voice had a softness that calmed the children.
items.exampleZh: 她的聲音有一種柔和，讓孩子們安靜下來。

items.exampleEn: Children love tactile books with soft and rough pages.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們很喜歡有軟有粗糙頁面、可以觸摸的書。

items.exampleEn: Gold is a fairly inert metal, so it stays bright for centuries.
items.exampleZh: 黃金是相當穩定（不易起反應）的金屬，所以幾百年都保持光亮。

items.exampleEn: The empty hall made our steps sound loud and resonant.
items.exampleZh: 空蕩蕩的大廳讓我們的腳步聲聽起來又響又有迴音。

items.exampleEn: Fire and water are elemental forces in many old stories.
items.exampleZh: 在許多古老的故事裡，火和水是大自然的基本力量。

items.exampleEn: The architect balanced beauty with practicality.
items.exampleZh: 那位建築師兼顧了美觀與實用性。

items.sentenceEn: The old church bell has a deep, resonant sound.
items.sentenceZh: 那座老教堂的鐘聲低沉而洪亮。

items.audioEn: The new phone looks unattractive, but people buy it for its long battery life.
items.audioZh: 新手機外型不好看，但大家買它是因為電池很耐用。
items.questionZh: 大家為什麼買這支手機？
options: The battery lasts a long time

items.sentenceEn: Making pots by hand is a very tactile hobby.
items.sentenceZh: 親手捏陶是一種很需要觸感的嗜好。

items.sentenceEn: For years the old machine sat inert in the corner of the garage.
items.sentenceZh: 那台舊機器多年來一動也不動地放在車庫角落。

items.stemEn: They celebrated their anniversary in a very ____ restaurant with live piano music.
items.stemZh: 他們在一間有現場鋼琴演奏的高級餐廳慶祝結婚紀念日。

items.stemEn: When I buy shoes, I care more about ____ than style.
items.stemZh: 買鞋時，我比較在意實用性，而不是款式。

items.passageEn: From the outside, our city's new science museum looks rather unattractive, but inside it is full of surprises. Visitors are asked to touch everything, and the tactile displays are popular with both children and blind visitors. You can feel the softness of a bird's feathers or hold a replica of a cold, inert rock from the moon. One room uses giant fans to show the elemental power of wind. In the last room, a guide with a resonant voice tells stories about the stars.
items.passageZh: 從外面看，我們市裡新的科學館不太好看，但裡面充滿驚喜。館方請參觀者盡量觸摸每樣東西，這些可觸摸的展品很受小孩和視障參觀者歡迎。你可以摸摸鳥羽毛的柔軟，或拿起一塊冰冷、靜止不動的月球岩石複製品。有一間展室用巨大的風扇展現風的自然力量。最後一間展室裡，一位聲音洪亮的導覽員講著星星的故事。

questions.questionZh: 這座科學館的特色是什麼？
有一間展室用什麼展現風的力量？

items.promptZh: 這條毯子很柔軟，讓我很快就睡著了。
referenceEn: The softness of this blanket helped me fall asleep quickly.
Thanks to the softness of this blanket, I fell asleep quickly.
rubricZh: 要用 softness 當名詞（例如 the softness of this blanket）
「很快睡著」可寫，例如 fell asleep quickly、fall asleep fast 等

items.promptZh: 那家飯店看起來很高級，但房價其實不貴。
referenceEn: That hotel looks posh, but its rooms are actually not expensive.
The hotel looks very posh, but the rooms are actually quite cheap.
rubricZh: posh 當形容詞「高級的」（例如 looks posh 等）
「房價不貴」可寫，例如 the rooms are not expensive、the rooms are quite cheap 等
「其實」可寫，例如 actually、in fact 等，位置不扣分
